item.title: HP and Dell disable HEVC support built into their laptops' CPUs
item.description:
📝 Laptops with sixth-generation Intel Core and later processors have built-in hardware support for HEVC decoding and encoding. For example, the product page for the Dell 16 Plus 2-in-1, which has HEVC hardware decoding disabled, makes no mention of HEVC. Check with your preferred video player for HEVC software support.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2025/11/hp-and-dell-disable-hevc-support-built-into-their-laptops-cpus/
